k017: Editorial independence. Transparent peer review. Independent expert assessment where needed. No payment for acceptance.
k032: Editorial decisions are made solely on the basis of quality, integrity, relevance and peer review. No payment, sponsorship or donation has any influence.
k034: WPA Journal has an Editorial Office and an Editorial Board. Reviewers are appointed separately and are not automatically members of the Editorial Board. Names are published only after written acceptance, an approved biography, a COI declaration and Public Listing Consent. WPA Journal does not use an Academic Advisory Board (AAB) as an editorial organ.
k040: similarity / plagiarism screening with editorial judgment; no automatic percentage threshold;
k043: Double-blind for research and methodology; practitioner review for practitioner pieces; editorial review for book reviews and teaching notes. Reviewers do not know payment / waiver status.
k045: Flagship, methodological or sensitive manuscripts may undergo additional independent expert review according to subject-matter competence.
k047: Accept · Accept with minor revisions · Accept with major revisions · Reject · Unsuitable for this journal.
k049: An appeal is submitted to the Editorial Office within the period stated in the decision. Where practicable, it is assessed by a different qualified editor and, when needed, a different independent reviewer. The editor who handled the original decision should not be the sole decision-maker on the appeal.
k051: When the Editor-in-Chief is an author or co-author, the manuscript is handled independently by the Deputy Editor-in-Chief or another designated qualified editor.
k052: The Editor-in-Chief does not participate in reviewer selection, peer-review management, editorial discussion or the final decision on their own manuscript.
k053: The same recusal rule applies to any editor with a relevant conflict of interest.
k055: Written acceptance, approved biography, COI declaration and Public Listing Consent are prerequisites for public listing.
k056: An invitation or informal conversation alone does not constitute board membership.
k058: All correction and retraction notices are publicly available and linked to the original article.
k060: Editorial decisions are separated from financial matters. No publication or production fee framework is currently active. Sponsorship or support cannot influence acceptance, rejection or peer review.
k062: A sponsor has no influence over editorial decisions, peer review, acceptance, rejection, authors, reviewers or journal content.
k064: WPA Journal publicly distinguishes current capability from roadmap status and does not claim ISSN, DOI, indexing or board participation without formal confirmation.
